finding: the first P1 runs under plan v4 r3's protocol (scripts/10_newton_scale_probe.py smoke rows) showed four protocol faults and six probe departures; the reviewer reproduced each with independent runs. (1) Finger contacts: the FR3 finger shapes kept Newton's default ShapeConfig (ke 2500, kd 100 -> solref 20 ms, damping ratio 1) and have geom_priority 1, so MuJoCo uses the finger's solref alone at every finger contact (about 1.1-1.3 kN/m against a 1x brick). At 1x the realised grip saturated at 1.2-2.0 N per finger for 2.9/14/100 N nominal (FINGER_KE had no effect), pads sank 0.9-1.6 mm, press slip was 1.1-1.8 mm, press force saturated at about 4-5 N (F_cap >= 10 N never triggered); carry slip was 1.60 mm at both scales whatever the grip and scales with the finger time constant (20/6.7/3.3/2.2 ms -> 1.60/0.47/0.19/0.095 mm); the wall-thickness explanation was refuted. With ke_f 2.5e5, kd_f 900 (16 substeps) at 1x: grip 6.9/13.2/24.9 N for 7.1/14.3/28.6 N nominal, pad penetration 0.09-0.24 mm (2x: 0.03-0.06), press slip 0.07-0.19 mm (2x: 0.08-0.23); ke 1e6 diverged at kd 500 and 1000 (the only values tried); side effect k_os rose from about 1.5 to 2.5-4.4 at 20 mm/s and F_cap 5 N (up to 3.8 at 1x; peaks 12.4-21.9 N). (2) Clutch gate: r3's dz edge +1.0s sat 0.1-0.37 mm below the 1x stud-top rest (+1.1 to +1.37 mm, creeping down about 19 um/s) and admitted the 2x stud-top rest (+1.84 after a 2 mm drop, +2.69 after 4 mm); the probe scored any frame, so a 20 mm/s descent passed in transit (every (d) row 'fired' at +0.71 to +0.96 mm at 1x, +1.92 to +1.99 mm at 2x). Seated and released, bricks rest at about 0 to +0.05 mm within 1 s at 1x (+0.06 to +0.10 after 3-6 s) and +0.05 to +0.18 mm at 2x; intermediate 1x end states exist (10 (b) trials in (+0.4, +1.0) mm; three (d) load trials at +0.24/+0.33/+0.35 mm, tilted 1.2-1.7 deg). (3) P1(c): raw 2 s peak-to-peak was 0.037-0.048 mm at 1x on free bricks (gate 0.02s), which is linear creep (-19 to +25 um/s); detrended <= 0.0022 mm (1x), <= 0.0043 mm (2x); under r3's gate 1x fails P1. (4) FK 'seated' false positives: at offsets >= 1 mm the soft-gripped hand slid 3 mm down the brick and FK reported seated with the brick at +1.3 mm. Departures: GRASP_DZ scaled, rig raised (lower brick at z = 0.05 m), collision every substep while the real-time gate used once per frame, c_held contiguous, proxy stud-wall clearance 0.70s mm in code (r3 said 0.6); smoke real-time factor on a shared GPU 0.35 / 0.55 / 0.90 at 16 / 8 / 4 substeps (465-brick pool)
implication: the r3-protocol P1 rows that involve the fingers, (b), (d), (e), (f), are void; the (a), (c) and (g) rows involve no fingers and stay valid, so newton_brick_press_tunnelling and section 0 fact 6 stand.
